summary: Iter 231k (Real-time trade_processed toast + drafts.py extraction into draft_queue.py/draft_auction.py + Mobile UX) fully validated. All 37 prior+new backend pytests pass (test_iter231k_draft_queue_auction_extraction 5/5, test_iter231j 9/9, test_iter231h 8/8, test_iter231g 4/4, test_iter170j 7/7, test_iter170m 4/4). New smoke probes against live endpoints (test_iter231k_smoke.py 5/5) confirm /api/users/me/pending-trades, /api/drafts, /api/teams/{id}/draft-queue, /api/teams/{id}/shortlist, and /api/drafts/{id}/auction/state all return 200/expected codes with no 5xx — the new draft_queue & draft_auction routers are correctly wired. Mobile (390x844) and Desktop (1920x800) Playwright runs as chriszarek@gmail.com confirm: banner chevrons + 48px+ rows (measured 56px mobile, 52px desktop), no horizontal scroll, welcome heading scales (30px mobile / 48px desktop), Trade Detail Accept/Reject buttons stack full-width 44px on mobile and side-by-side right-aligned on desktop, hover state lightens row bg + cyan chevron (rgb(0,210,255)). AppLayout.jsx confirmed to subscribe to 'trade_processed' via useGlobalSocketEvent with sonner toast + 'View' action deep-linking to /transactions/trade/{trade_id}.
critical_code_review_comments: drafts.py shrunk 2894 -> 2526 lines (-13%) and the ratchet guard (<2600) prevents regression. Both new modules (draft_queue.py ~127 LoC, draft_auction.py ~336 LoC) are focused and within size budget.
trade_engine.py emits 'trade_processed' globally (without a room) — correct for a league-wide broadcast since AppLayout subscribes via the global socket connection (not room-scoped).
AppLayout 'View' action uses navigate(`/transactions/trade/${payload.trade_id}`) — matches the deep-link route already used by PendingTradesBanner rows. Good consistency.

PendingTradesBanner rows have min-h-[48px] and 56px measured height on mobile — exceeds Apple HIG (44pt) and Material (48dp) touch-target minimums. Chevron is always visible (not hover-only) on mobile, which fixes the prior discoverability gap.

Pre-existing (unrelated to this iter): GET /api/drafts returns mongo `_id` directly instead of normalizing to `id` — leak of ObjectId-style key into the wire format. Low priority but worth normalizing in a future cleanup pass.

Pre-existing (unrelated): wss://.../api/socket.io WebSocket handshake returns 403 in preview env — surfaces as noisy console errors but does NOT block any HTTP-based functionality. The trade_processed toast will only fire when WS is reachable; cannot be observed end-to-end in this preview env. Code path is correctly wired (verified statically in AppLayout.jsx lines 40-54).
